info.title: Sentence breakdown
info.summary: Break down a Croatian, German, French or Italian sentence, and learn with flashcards.
info.description: A text in a study language becomes sentences and words, each word with its lemma, its tags and the problems that the checks found. On request, the result has the English translation and the links between the words of the two sides.

get.description: The decks, each with the card counts of the user.

The next card of the queue, with the breakdown of its prompt and with
no answers. `done` if the user is through for now.

Ask the AI a question about a text in the study language. Only a
question with `where` "sentence".

429.description: The limit of the user for a day

post.description:
Ask the AI a question about an answer of the user to a flashcard. The
server reads the card and the answer from the review. A question with
`where` "sentence" is about the side of the card in the study language.

429.description: The limit of the user for a day

503.description: No key for an AI service, or the models are not on the disk

get.description:
Whether a voice service is set up, its model, and the languages that
it reads aloud. With no service, the page has no "Listen" buttons.

Read a text aloud: the mp3 from the voice service. The text goes to
that service. 422 with the code `voice-language` when the service does not
read the language.

schema.description: The language of the text: a `code` from /api/v1/languages, or "en".

503.description: No voice service is set up

get.description:
The courses, by folder name, and their lessons in order, each with the
progress of the user. A course or a lesson that does not parse is left
out, and the log has the error.

The mp3 of a lesson. FileResponse answers a Range request, so the
player can jump.
The parsed script of a lesson.

put.description:
Save where the user is in a lesson. The lesson is finished the first
time that the position is within a few seconds of the end, and stays
finished.

get.description:
The study languages, English as the other side, and whether the page
ticks "Large models" by default.
The languages that the page has its text in.
The messages of the page in one language, as a Fluent file.
Which models are in memory, and which one loads at this moment.

post.description:
Break a text into sentences and words, with the lemma, the tags and
the grammar problems of each word. A translation that fails is an `error`
in `translation`, and the breakdown is still there.

503.description: The models are not on the disk

get.description: The lemmas that were in the most texts, for one language.

form.title: Form
form.description: The word with its accent marks. " / " is between two possible forms.

exact.title: Exact
exact.description: False: the accent is that of the dictionary form, and not of this form.

ambiguous.title: Ambiguous
ambiguous.description: The data has more than one accented form for this word.

clitic.title: Clitic
clitic.description: The word has no accent of its own.

typed.title: Typed
typed.description: What the user entered. Empty for "I do not know".

heavy.title: Heavy
heavy.description: Use the heavy models of the study language for the breakdown.

elapsed_ms.title: Elapsed Ms
elapsed_ms.description: How long the user looked at the card, in milliseconds.

review_id.title: Review Id
review_id.description: The key for a change of the rating.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: The automatic rating: 1 Again, 2 Hard, 3 Good, 4 Easy.

next_due.title: Next Due
next_due.description: When the card comes again, ISO 8601.

diff.title: Diff
diff.description:
The typed answer against the closest accepted answer. "delete" is a
typed part that is wrong, and "insert" is a part that is missing.

media.title: Media
media.description: The images and the sound clips of the answer.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The text of the prompt. A "listen" card has it only here.

typed.description: The typed answer, with the checks and the links to the prompt.

correct.description: The closest accepted answer, with the links to the prompt.

id.title: Id
id.description: The name of the folder in DATA_ROOT/audio/, for the other routes.

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.description: In order. A lesson whose script does not parse is not here.

audio.title: Audio
audio.description:
"ready": the mp3 is newer than the script. "stale": the script changed
after the mp3 was made. "none": the lesson has no mp3.

position.title: Position
position.description:
Where the user stopped, in seconds. 0 if the user never played the
lesson.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description:
The length of the mp3 in seconds, as the player of the user saw it. 0
if the user never played the lesson.

finished.title: Finished
finished.description: The user once got to the end of the lesson.

grammar.title: Grammar
grammar.description: The grammar step of the lesson.

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: In the order of the mp3.

speaker.title: Speaker
speaker.description: The narrator speaks English. The actors speak the study language.

seconds.title: Seconds
seconds.description: The length of a pause. 0 for a spoken line.

position.title: Position
position.description: Where the player is, in seconds.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: The length of the mp3 in seconds, as the player sees it.

position.title: Position
position.description: In seconds. A position after the end is the end.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: The length of the mp3 in seconds, as in the request.

finished.title: Finished
finished.description: The user once got to within a few seconds of the end.

text.title: Text
text.description: The text to break down, in the language of `source`.

heavy.title: Heavy
heavy.description:
Use the heavy models of the study language. They are more exact, and
the first request waits for their load. English only has a light model.

nonstandard.title: Nonstandard
nonstandard.description: Use the heavy models for casual text. Only Croatian has them.

track.title: Track
track.description: Count each lemma of the text, for `seen` and for /api/v1/lemmas.

translate.title: Translate
translate.description:
Also translate the text to English, and link the words of the two
sides.

source.title: Source
source.description:
Which side the user entered. "en": translate the text to the study
language first, and break down that text. `translate` and `nonstandard`
then have no effect, because the translator writes the standard language.

type.title: Type
type.description:
The model type that made the breakdown: "light", "heavy" or
"nonstandard".

text.title: Text
text.description:
The text in the study language: from the user, or from the translator.
Empty after a translation that failed.

sentences.title: Sentences
sentences.description: The side of the study language.

translation.description: The English side. Only with `translate`, or with the source "en".

new.title: New
new.description: The cards that the user never answered.

learning.title: Learning
learning.description: The cards in the short learning steps.

due.title: Due
due.description: The cards in review whose next review time is now or in the past.

path.title: Path
path.description:
The place in the deck tree, for a deck of a package with subdecks:
["Croatian sentences", "Read", "2"]. Empty for a deck on its own.

where.title: Where
where.description:
"sentence": about a text, for each of the two routes. "card": about an
answer to a flashcard, only for the route of a review.

user_context.title: User Context
user_context.description:
What the user wants to add to the question. It goes into the prompt as
data of the user.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: The language of the answer: a `code` from /api/v1/locales.

text.title: Text
text.description: The answer of the model, as plain text. It can be wrong.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that wrote the answer.

cached.title: Cached
cached.description: The answer is from an earlier, equal request.

user_context.title: User Context
user_context.description:
What the user wants to add to the question. It goes into the prompt as
data of the user.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: The language of the answer: a `code` from /api/v1/locales.

text.title: Text
text.description: A text in the study language.

code.title: Code
code.description: ISO 639-1. This is the `language` of a request.

tag_name.title: Tag Name
tag_name.description: The name of the xpos tag set.

placeholder.title: Placeholder
placeholder.description: An example text for the input field.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: The model types. The first one is the default.

light_note.title: Light Note
light_note.description: What the light model cannot do, if the heavy one can.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: The direction of the script: the `dir` of a text in this language.

speech.title: Speech
speech.description: The BCP 47 tag for the speech synthesis of the browser.

dictionary_links.title: Dictionary Links
dictionary_links.description: (label, address). "{lemma}" in either one becomes the lemma of a word.

ui_locale.title: Ui Locale
ui_locale.description:
The `code` of the page text in this language (/api/v1/locales). Empty:
the page has no text in this language.

native_name.title: Native Name
native_name.description: The name of the language in the language.

english.description: The other side of each study language.

large_by_default.title: Large By Default
large_by_default.description:
True: TLHELPER_ALWAYS_LARGE is 1, as in the compose file. The page then
ticks "Large models" until the user makes a choice.

links.title: Links
links.description:
Pairs [word of the study language, English word] from the dictionary.
An index counts the words of all the sentences of a side, from 0.

guesses.title: Guesses
guesses.description: Pairs like links, but only from the position of the two words.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the language in the language, for example "Hrvatski".

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: The direction of the script: the `dir` of the page.

default.title: Default
default.description:
The complete catalog. A message that another catalog does not have
comes from this one.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description:
"to_study": the prompt is English, and the user enters the study
language. "to_english" is the other way round. "listen" and "dictation":
the prompt is a sound clip with no text, and the user enters the English
or the study language. The answer gives the text of a "listen" card.

media.title: Media
media.description: The images and the sound clips of the prompt.

next_due.title: Next Due
next_due.description: When the next card comes, ISO 8601. Null: the deck has no more cards.

key.title: Key
key.description: The id of a message in /api/v1/locales/{code}/ui.ftl.

params.title: Params
params.description:
The parameters of the message. A value is a raw tag ("Loc"), and the
catalog has the word for it.

available.title: Available
available.description: False: the server has no key for an AI service, so each request fails.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that answers. Empty if none is set.

questions.title: Questions
questions.description: In the order of the buttons.

available.title: Available
available.description: A voice service is set up. If not, the page has no "Listen" buttons.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that reads aloud. Empty if none is set.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description:
The codes of the languages that the service reads aloud: study
languages, and "en".

passed.title: Passed
passed.description: The reviews with a rating other than "Again".

counts.title: Counts
counts.description: The sum over the decks. Empty if there is no deck.

success_rate.title: Success Rate
success_rate.description: The share of the reviews that were not "Again". Null with no reviews.

lapses.title: Lapses
lapses.description: How often a card in review got "Again".

days.title: Days
days.description:
One entry for each of the last days, the oldest first. A day starts at
00:00 UTC.

loading.title: Loading
loading.description: The model that loads at this moment, for example "Croatian heavy".

links.title: Links
links.description:
Pairs [word of the study language, English word] from the dictionary.
An index counts the words of all the sentences of a side, from 0.

guesses.title: Guesses
guesses.description: Pairs like links, but only from the position of the two words.

error.title: Error
error.description:
Why there is no translation, in English. The other keys can then be
absent.

error_code.title: Error Code
error_code.description:
The message "error-{error_code}" of /api/v1/locales/{code}/ui.ftl has
the same text for a page in another language. Not for each error.

users.title: Users
users.description: The own entry first. The other users are only there for an admin.

id.title: Id
id.description: The position in the sentence, from 1.

upos.title: Upos
upos.description: The Universal POS tag, for example "NOUN".

xpos.title: Xpos
xpos.description: The tag of the tag set of the language (LanguageInfo.tag_name).

head.title: Head
head.description:
The `id` of the word that this word depends on. 0 for the root of the
sentence, and for a tagger with no parser (classla).

deprel.title: Deprel
deprel.description:
The relation to the head, in the labels of the model: "obj" for
Croatian (Universal Dependencies), "oa" for German (TIGER). Empty for a
tagger with no parser.

start_char.title: Start Char
start_char.description: The position of the first letter in the text.

end_char.title: End Char
end_char.description: The position after the last letter in the text.

problems.title: Problems
problems.description:
What the grammar and spelling checks found, in English. Only with the
checks.

problem_messages.title: Problem Messages
problem_messages.description:
The message of each entry of `problems`, in the same order, for a page
in another language. Null for a problem with no message. Absent if the
word has no problem.

accent.description: The pitch accent. Only for Croatian, and null for a word with no data.

reading.title: Reading
reading.description:
How to say the word, for a script that does not show it. No language
of today gives it.

seen.title: Seen
seen.description:
How often the lemma was in a text before. Null for a lemma with no
count, for example punctuation. Only in /api/v1/classify.

tags.name: flashcards
tags.description: The decks and the cards of a user.

tags.name: speech
tags.description: A text read aloud by the voice service.

tags.name: audio lessons
tags.description: The spoken courses of the admin.
